A comprehensive summary for our work would be that

we present a new computation flow SFS and a corresponding data format CSF to make the best use of data sparsity and simplify data handling, and we also propose a new 3D SIMD processor architecture to illustrate the acceleration of deep CNNs by using SFS and CSF.

we have presented a novel computation flow and corresponding data encoding format to make the best use of data sparsity in deep CNNs, and a 3D SIMD processor architecture to accelerate deep CNN inference by taking advantage of these methods.

, by taking advantage of data sparsity and simplifying computation flow, we achieve a 1.11x storage reduction for AlexNet and 1.9x storage reduction for SqueezeNet, with no loss of accuracy, and a 3.65 x PE utilization rate improvement on our 3D SIMD processor.
The main takeaway from our work is that
the data sparsity of deep neural network is a valuable resource that can be used to simplify data handling and accelerate computation, and the SFS flow is a good example to demonstrate this idea.

by using a stationary flow and an indexed sparse data encoding format we can simplify the data handling and improve the efficiency of hardware oriented CNN acceleration, which is important in terms of chip area, power consumption and processing performance.
the data sparsity and data locality in CNNs can be exploited in a way that is both effective and efficient.
